name: Nazareth
line: Nazareth was a town in Galilee where Mary lived and Jesus grew up, and where the people drove Him out after He spoke in the synagogue.

moments.title: Gabriel Visits Mary
moments.text: God sent the angel Gabriel to Mary, a virgin pledged to Joseph. He told her she would bear a Son named Jesus, and Mary answered, "I am the Lord's servant."

moments.title: Joseph Settles Here
moments.text: After an angel told Joseph in a dream to leave Egypt, he feared Archelaus. Warned in a dream, he took the Child and His mother to live in Nazareth.

moments.title: Jesus Grows Up
moments.text: Jesus' parents returned to their own town of Nazareth, and the Child grew strong and wise. After He was found in the temple at twelve, He went down to Nazareth and was obedient to them.

moments.title: Jesus Reads Isaiah
moments.text: On the Sabbath Jesus stood in the synagogue, read from Isaiah, and said, "Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing." The people grew enraged and drove Him out of town to throw Him off a cliff.
